events.text: N class 2-6-0 locomotive designed by Richard Maunsell for mixed traffic.

evidence.quote: designed in 1914 by Richard Maunsell
The N class was designed by Maunsell in 1914

events.text: First N class locomotive No. 810 emerged from Ashford for proving trials; construction 1917-1934.

evidence.quote: Built between 1917 and 1934
the first N class rolled out of Ashford Works in 1917
emerged from Ashford Works for proving trials in July 1917

events.text: No. 810 entered service; the N class introduced on the SECR.

evidence.quote: Entering service in August 1917
When introduced in 1917

events.text: Another 15 locomotives (Nos. 811-825) ordered by the SECR.

evidence.quote: were ordered in 1919

events.text: Batch of Nos. 811-825 built, construction running to 1923.

evidence.quote: These were built between 1920 and 1923

events.text: First locomotive of the 1920 batch left Ashford Works.

evidence.quote: The first left Ashford Works in June 1920

events.text: SECR absorbed into Southern Railway at Grouping; N class passed to Southern Railway.

evidence.quote: After The Grouping in 1923
which had absorbed the SECR in the 1923 Grouping

events.label: livery
events.text: Standard sage green livery applied to class after Grouping.

evidence.quote: After Grouping in 1923

events.text: Woolwich prefabricated components formed 100 complete N class kits.

evidence.quote: By 1924 , the prefabricated components stored at Woolwich formed 100 complete N class kits

events.label: trials
events.text: Southern Railway trialled N class against N1, S15 and K classes for freight.

evidence.quote: undertook trials in early 1924

events.text: Southern Railway bought 50 Woolwich kits for Ashford assembly, June 1924 to August 1925.

evidence.quote: bought fifty Woolwich kits for assembly at Ashford between June 1924 and August 1925

events.label: livery
events.text: Class repainted in darker olive green livery introduced by Maunsell.

evidence.quote: From 1925 , the class was repainted in a darker olive green livery

events.label: modification
events.text: All stovepipe chimneys replaced with standard N class chimney.

evidence.quote: all stovepipes had been replaced with the standard N class type by April 1927

events.text: Southern Railway renumbered all its locomotives into one sequence; N class became Nos. 1810-1875.

evidence.quote: From 1928 , a new system was adopted where all Southern Railway locomotives were renumbered into one sequence

events.text: Southern Railway ordered final batch of 15 locomotives (Nos. 1400-1414), built to 1934.

evidence.quote: In 1932 , the Southern Railway ordered a final batch of 15 locomotives
The final batch of 15 locomotives , built between 1932 and 1934

events.label: modification
events.text: Class-wide modifications began: new domes, front footsteps and smoke deflectors.

evidence.quote: no class-wide modifications were made until 1934

events.label: livery
events.text: All N class locomotives painted in plain black during wartime shortages.

evidence.quote: locomotives were painted in plain black by 1945

events.text: Entire class absorbed into British Railways ownership.

evidence.quote: The entire class came into British Railways ownership in 1948
The class was absorbed by British Railways in 1948

events.label: classification
events.text: Class given power classification 4MT by British Railways.

evidence.quote: initially given the power classification 4MT in 1949

events.label: livery
events.text: Repainted in BR mixed-traffic livery and renumbered to BR standard series (31810-31875, 31400-31414).

evidence.quote: From 1949 to 1950 N class locomotives were repainted in the British Railways

events.label: classification
events.text: Class reclassified from 4MT to 4P5FB by British Railways.

evidence.quote: the class was reclassified from 4MT to 4P5FB in 1953

events.label: modification
events.text: Some class locomotives fitted with larger BR Standard Class 4 chimneys.

evidence.quote: From 1957 , some of the locomotives had larger-diameter BR Standard Class 4 chimneys fitted

events.label: modification
events.text: New injectors fitted to the class as part of final modifications.

evidence.quote: the fitting of new injectors and Automatic Warning System ( AWS ) equipment in 1957 and 1959 respectively

events.label: modification
events.text: Automatic Warning System equipment fitted to the class.

evidence.quote: the fitting of new injectors and Automatic Warning System ( AWS ) equipment in 1957 and 1959 respectively

events.text: Phased withdrawal of the class began with No. 31409.

events.label: withdrawal

evidence.quote: Class members based at Exmouth Junction shed were withdrawn in 1964
